fields.title: Step
fields.description: The step size by which the value is increased after each iteration. Negative step sizes are possible, if from is greater than to.

fields.title: Loop variable type
fields.description: Select the type of the variable that is exposed by the node (integers, longs or doubles). The node creates variables for from, to, step and the current value. Keep in mind that this only affects the type of the variables. Internally doubles are used to keep track of the loop state. This means that the values may be rounded to fit the specified type.

fields.title: Variable prefix
fields.description: The prefix of the variable names.
